name: The Ordinary and The Extraordinary
source:
Play as Bailey (gender up to interpretation),  a bartender on the surface, but actually is an informant in disguise.

Help two distinct client that regularly visits not only for information of their target, but also to vent their work and life problems.

Is it better to live a risky extraordinary life or have a comfortable life as an ordinary people?

[from [url=https://nekokarasu.itch.io/the-ordinary-and-the-extarordinary]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演贝利（性别由解释），表面上是调酒师，但实际上是伪装的线人。

帮助两个不同的客户定期拜访，不仅是为了了解他们的目标，也是为了发泄他们的工作和生活问题。

过冒险的非凡生活好还是过安逸的普通人生活好？

[来自[url=https://nekokarasu.itch.io/the-ordinary-and-the-extarordinary]itch.io[/url]]
